answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 24097 Country: India Title: Can girls be the witness in or during Nikaah? (Kya Khawateen bhi Nikaah mein gawaah banai jaa sakti hain)? Question: Can girls be the witness in or during Nikaah? (Kya Khawateen bhi Nikaah mein gawaah banai jaa sakti hain?) Answer ID: 24097 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1201/912/L=1431) If there are two women along with one man then they can become witness in nikah. Only women though many cannot become witness. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
